name: glyph3d-hero
description: glyph3d hero demo — the product demonstrating itself. A minimal react-three-fiber app on @glyph3d/core + glyph3d-r3f: one GlyphCanvas + CodeGrid, drag to orbit, wheel to zoom, type to fill. Built static and iframed by glyph3d.dev. Doubles as the canonical 'plug it in like this' sample.
